ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious Event Viewer Child Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects uncommon or suspicious child processes of "eventvwr.exe" which might indicate a UAC bypass attempt

sequences.query: parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\eventvwr\\\.exe$") AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\mmc\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\WerFault\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\WerFault\\\.exe$")))
